customer_segment: Mass-market retail banking customers in Latin America (Brazil/Mexico/Colombia) seeking low-friction everyday banking and access to financial services
end_activity: Successfully manage day-to-day money flows and financial needs (payments, savings, borrowing) with minimal fees and friction

activities.activity: Recognize a need for a better banking relationship (lower fees, less friction, more convenience) and decide to switch or add an account
activities.current_provider: Self (customer), influenced by experiences with incumbent banks
activities.customer_goal: Identify that current banking experience is painful/expensive and that an alternative is worth trying

activities.activity: Discover and evaluate banking options (digital vs incumbent), comparing trust, fees, and ease of use
activities.current_provider: Incumbent banks (as comparison baseline) and Nubank (as a digital-first alternative)
activities.customer_goal: Choose a provider that reduces the perceived hassle and fee burden while still meeting core banking needs

activities.activity: Open an account and complete onboarding/verification to start the relationship
activities.customer_goal: Get an active account with minimal onboarding friction so banking can begin immediately

activities.activity: Move money in and use the account for everyday banking (receive funds, pay bills, make transfers, transact)
activities.current_provider: Nubank or incumbent banks; external counterparties (employers, billers, merchants) participate in the workflow
activities.customer_goal: Execute routine payments and money movement reliably with fewer fees and less effort than traditional banks

activities.activity: Add additional financial services when needed (e.g., credit or other financial products) without redoing the whole banking setup
activities.customer_goal: Meet new financial needs (especially in a fee-heavy incumbent environment) using the same provider relationship if it is simpler/cheaper

activities.activity: Get support, manage settings, and periodically reassess the relationship (stay, expand usage, or revert to incumbents)
activities.current_provider: Nubank or incumbent banks; self (customer) for reassessment
activities.customer_goal: Resolve issues quickly and ensure the ongoing banking experience remains low-friction and cost-effective

profile_vs_cvc_conflicts: Company profile frames the user as a standalone retail banking customer, but the customer value chain necessarily includes external ecosystem participants (employers depositing wages, billers/merchants receiving payments) that shape switching friction and daily usage (E3, E4).

Profile states 'accounts and financial services' but provides no detail on which services; the CVC therefore includes a generic 'add services (e.g., credit)' step that may not match Nubank’s exact current product scope in each country (evidence gap) (E3).
